title: Early Civilisation
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): ancient Egypt on the Nile; Great Zimbabwe built by the ancestors of the Shona; Kongo near the Congo River mouth under the Manikongo.

skills.key_step: The child gives the factors that helped Egypt, Great Zimbabwe and Kongo grow.

floor.prerequisite: Names the main features of Eastern Africa.
floor.question: Which river flows out of Lake Victoria?

representations: a factor table for three kingdoms

board.do: Draw three columns: Egypt, Great Zimbabwe, Kongo.
Wait for the Nile floods and farming.

listen_for: The yearly floods of the Nile
misconceptions.ask: Which factor helped Great Zimbabwe grow?
misconceptions.repair: Ask where the Nile flows and where Great Zimbabwe stood.

misconceptions.ask: Who built the stone walls of Great Zimbabwe?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which people live around the site today.

misconceptions.ask: Besides gold, what helped Great Zimbabwe grow?
misconceptions.repair: List what people ate and traded there.

misconceptions.ask: What kind of land helped Kongo grow?
misconceptions.repair: Show the Congo basin on a vegetation map.

checks.question: Give one factor that helped ancient Egypt grow.
checks.answer: the fertile Nile valley and its floods, or farming

checks.question: Who built Great Zimbabwe?
checks.answer: the ancestors of the Shona people

skills.key_step: The child places the three kingdoms on a map of Africa.

floor.prerequisite: Describes the position of Africa and its features.
floor.question: Which sea is north of Africa?

board.do: Draw Africa with the Nile, Congo and Zambezi.
Point at the Nile's northern end.

misconceptions.ask: In which part of Africa was ancient Egypt?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which sea lies to the north of Egypt.
Ask which kingdom lay at the mouth of the Congo River.

misconceptions.ask: Is Great Zimbabwe on the East African coast?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the trade route from Great Zimbabwe to Sofala on the coast.

listen_for: The southern end near Lake Victoria
misconceptions.ask: Which end of the Nile was ancient Egypt on?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the Nile from Jinja north to Egypt.

checks.question: In which region of Africa was Great Zimbabwe?
Near which river was the Kingdom of Kongo?

skills.key_step: The child says what the three kingdoms gave the modern world.

floor.prerequisite: Gives the factors that helped the kingdoms grow.
floor.question: What helped Great Zimbabwe grow?

representations: gift cards to match to kingdoms
steps: Say how we use it today.

board.do: Write hieroglyphs, dry-stone walls, copper work.

misconceptions.ask: Which kingdom is famous for hieroglyphs and papyrus?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which kingdom is famous for stone walls without mortar.

misconceptions.ask: Do ancient African kingdoms still matter to the world today?
Which ancient kingdom gave an early 365-day calendar?
misconceptions.repair: Link the Nile flood cycle to counting the year.

misconceptions.ask: How were the walls of Great Zimbabwe built?
misconceptions.repair: Stack flat stones carefully to make a small wall without glue.

checks.question: Which kingdom gave hieroglyphs and papyrus?
Do ancient African kingdoms still matter today?
checks.answer: Yes, their ideas are still used
